Put a güllaç sheet in a tray and moisten: Layer up to halfway, moistening each layer, and sprinkle with walnuts.
Cover with the remaining sheets in the same way.
Chill for 3 hours and serve with pomegranate.
The milk should be lukewarm so the sheets absorb it easily.
Semolina orange cake (in syrup)
Syrup: 2 cups sugar, 2.5 cups orange juice
Boil the syrup for 10 minutes and let cool.
Mix the batter ingredients.
Bake in a greased tray at 180 °C for 30 minutes.
Pour the cold syrup over the hot cake.
Slice once it has absorbed the syrup.
Orange juice gives the syrup a fresh aroma.
At room temperature.
Ekmek kadayıfı (quick)
1 packet ekmek kadayıfı
3 cups sugar
200 g kaymak or strained yogurt
3 tablespoons pistachios
Boil the sugar and water for 10 minutes and add the lemon.
Put the kadayıf in a tray and pour over half the hot syrup.
Let it absorb the syrup over low heat for 10 minutes, turn and add the remaining syrup.
Wait until the kadayıf has fully absorbed the syrup.
Chocolate mousse (with avocado)
Peel the avocados and put them in the blender.
Add the cocoa, honey, milk and salt.
Blend until smooth.
Chill for 1 hour and serve.
The avocado taste disappears completely with the cocoa.
Baked apple-cinnamon oat dessert (in bowls)
Dice the apples and divide between bowls.
Rub the oats, butter, honey, cinnamon and walnuts together and sprinkle on top.
Bake for 20 minutes.
A practical dessert in single-serving bowls.
Lukewarm, with yogurt.
Lokma (homemade fried dough balls)
Syrup: 2 cups sugar, 2 cups water, half a lemon
Boil the syrup and let cool.
Make a runny batter with the flour, yeast, sugar, salt and water and leave to rise for 1 hour.
Squeeze the batter through your hand and drop into hot oil with a wet spoon.
Fry, turning, until golden.
Drop the hot lokma into the cold syrup and leave for 1 minute.
If the oil is too hot, the inside won’t cook.
Pan-fried anchovies (hamsi tava)
1 kg anchovies (cleaned)
Wash and drain the anchovies.
Mix the cornmeal and salt.
Coat the anchovies in the flour and arrange in the pan in a fan shape.
Fry in hot oil for 2 minutes on each side.
Serve with lemon and onion.
Don’t over-flour; shake off the excess.
Hot, with cornbread.
Steamed sea bass (buğulama)
4 mushrooms
1 teaspoon salt, dill
Slice the onion into rings and the vegetables into slices.
Spread the vegetables in a pan and place the fish on top.
Add oil, lemon, salt and half a glass of water.
Cook covered over low heat for 15–18 minutes.
Buğulama cooks in its own steam; don’t add too much water.
Creamy shrimp sauté
Stir the garlic and pepper in butter for 2 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2 minutes until pink.
Shrimp is cooked once pink; any longer toughens it.
Hot, with rice or bread.
Oven-baked bonito
4 bonito steaks
Slice the onions into rings and spread on the tray.
Arrange the fish on top and add tomato slices.
Add oil, lemon and spices.
The bed of onions stops the fish from sticking.
With rocket.
Fried mussels (homemade)
500 g shelled mussels
1 cup cold beer or sparkling mineral water
1 teaspoon salt, bicarbonate of soda
Tarator: 1 slice bread, half a cup walnuts, 1 garlic clove, 2 tablespoons yogurt
Make a runny batter with the flour, salt, bicarbonate of soda and cold liquid.
Pat the mussels dry and dip in the batter.
Fry in hot oil for 2 minutes.
Blitz the tarator ingredients in a food processor.
Serve the mussels with the tarator.
Cold liquid makes the batter crisp.
Grilled salmon (with lemon butter)
Season the salmon with salt and black pepper.
Cook skin side down on a griddle pan for 5 minutes.
Melt the garlic and lemon in butter to make a sauce.
Drizzle the sauce over the salmon.
Once the skin crisps, it releases from the pan by itself.
With rice and vegetables.
Oven-baked sardines
1 kg sardines (cleaned)
Pat the sardines dry and arrange on a tray.
Mix the oil, lemon juice, crushed garlic, thyme and salt and pour over.
Sardines are very rich in omega-3.
Hot, with rocket.
Calamari (oven-baked)
500 g calamari rings
Pat the calamari dry.
Coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Arrange on a tray and drizzle with oil.
Calamari should be cooked either very briefly or for a long time; in between, it turns rubbery.
With tarator or lemon.
Fish soup
500 g boneless white fish
1 celery stick
Dice the vegetables and stir in oil for 5 minutes.
Break the fish into pieces, add and cook for 8 minutes.
Season with lemon and salt.
Add the fish last so it doesn’t break up.
Stuffed mackerel (oven-baked)
4 mackerel (bones removed)
2 tablespoons currants
2 tablespoons pine nuts
1 dessert spoon allspice, salt
Fry the onion in oil, add the rice, currants, pine nuts and spices; cook with half a glass of water for 10 minutes.
Stuff the mackerel with the filling.
Arrange on a tray and brush with oil.
Bake at 190 °C for 25 minutes.
